description: Department of Local Government - NWP - under Section 66(G), meeting for the Purpose of electing the Chairman for the Panduwasnuwara P/S, will be held of 10.00 am on 08.07.2021 - under Section 66(G), meeting for the Purpose of electing the Chairman for the Puttalam U/C will be he held at 10.30 am on 01.07.2021
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively concerns the scheduling of meetings for electing chairpersons of local government bodies (Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha and Puttlam Urban Council). It falls under electoral processes at the local government level, specifically meeting announcements for leadership elections, which aligns perfectly with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes and related matters.
